spans.s:
गाध् {c1c} A. (गाधते, गाधित)
1 To
stand, stay, remain.
--2 To set out
for; dive or plunge into; गाधितासे
नभो भूयः

; 8. 1.
--3 To seek,
search or inquire for.
--4 To compile,
string or weave together.
गध्य a. Ved. To be seized (as booty).

गाध a. [गाध्-भवादौ घञ्] Fordable,
not very deep, shallow; सरितः कुर्वती
गाधाः पथश्चाश्यानकर्दमान्

; cf.
अगाध.
--धं
1 A shallow place, ford.
--2 A place, site.
--3 Desire of gain,
cupidity.
--4 Bottom.

गाधिः, गाधिन् m. [गाध-इन्] N. of
the father of Viśvāmitra (he is
supposed to have been an incarnation of
Indra and born as the son of king
Kauśāmba).
--Comp.
--जः, --नंदनः, --पुत्रः
an epithet of Viśvāmitra.
--नगरं, --पुरं
an epithet of Kānyakubja, the
modern Kanoja.
